Update an installed `monkeys` with one command, using its installation method
and directory.

### Added

- `monkeys update` installs the latest release. `monkeys upgrade` is an alias.
  Homebrew installations use `brew upgrade eastriverlee/tap/monkeys`. Direct
  installations use the release installer and update the running executable's
  directory, including when it was reached through a symlink.

### Changed

- The release installer requires the published checksum and stages the new
  executable beside the installed one before replacing it. Download,
  verification or extraction failures leave the installed executable intact.
